clips.title: The story
paras: In human lands, a night elf priest receives a summons to return to Teldrassil. Brother Joshua delivers the message from Priestess Alathea, who calls the young priest to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus for advanced guidance in Elune’s mysteries.

Night elf priests sometimes travel to human lands such as Stormwind to share spiritual fellowship with the Church of the Holy Light. Their deepest ties remain with the Sisterhood of Elune. Brother Joshua tells an acolyte that a night elf emissary has come searching for them. Their early travels are over, and their home temple calls them back for deeper training with High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind’s inner circle.

Across the sea, Darnassus welcomes the returning priest at the Temple of the Moon. Priestess Alathea greets the acolyte warmly and celebrates their safe passage through a troubled world. Their return brings joy to Alathea and Tyrande, while more demanding spiritual trials await.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A priestess recently visited our halls seeking you out, young traveler. She said that she was on a mission to find you and that you should return to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus as soon as possible. When you arrive, seek out a Priestess Alathea--she will tell you more.
The Light be with you, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wonderful, you've returned home, friend. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does Elune still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
